title: AI Math Benchmark & Agentic Tool
description: Developed a leading AI math benchmark.
details: Developed a leading AI math benchmark and agentic tool while working at Epoch AI.

title: Educore (3D Game Engine)
description: High-level editor for developing educational 3D games.
details: Educore is a high-level editor for developing educational 3D games. It is built in C++ on top of sokol.

title: Redactor (Lightweight IDE)
description: Lightweight, extensible C++ text editor with language server support, a built-in terminal, and Git and pull request tools.
details: Redactor is a lightweight, extensible text editor written in C++20 with SDL3. It has a custom immediate-mode UI, embedded Umka and Lua scripting, and a built-in terminal.
Features include multiple cursors, split panes, Vim mode, tree-sitter highlighting, language server support, a Git sidebar, and an agent panel for coding agents.

title: Spec-Driven Development Prototype
description: Prototype for spec-driven development, built as part of the ARIA Safeguarded AI program.
details: A prototype for spec-driven development, built during a short-term contract at Hash AI as part of the ARIA Safeguarded AI program.

title: GATE: AI Automation Model
description: Integrated assessment model simulating how AI automation affects growth, investment, and innovation, with an interactive sandbox.
details: GATE is an integrated assessment model for AI automation. It combines a compute-based model of AI development, an automation framework, and a semi-endogenous growth model.
An interactive sandbox lets you test different scenarios and policies.

title: Data Visualization Framework
description: Reusable data visualization framework built on top of D3, plus a Web Components UI system that standardizes website design.
details: A reusable data visualization framework built on top of D3, plus a Web Components UI system that standardizes website design.
Built while working at Epoch AI with researchers to turn complex data into usable interfaces.

title: Language Learning App
description: Web app for learning languages, starting with German.
details: German vocabulary flashcards with spaced-repetition scoring, plus chat, writing feedback, and a reader that uses the bookmarks API.
Built with Preact and Vite. Pronunciation audio is generated and stored by the backend API.

title: Hireme.sk Job Board
description: Job board that collects high-impact job listings from partner boards such as 80,000 Hours, Probably Good, CEA, and Effective Animal Advocacy, filtered for Slovakia and worldwide roles.
details: Hireme.sk collects high-impact job listings from partner job boards and highlights roles relevant to job seekers in Slovakia or elsewhere in the world.

title: Altfresh Bookmarking App
description: Reading app that saves web links, uploaded files, and pasted text, with customizable display, text-to-speech, highlights, and notes.
details: Altfresh saves web links, uploaded files, and pasted text so you can read them with customizable display settings.
You can listen to content aloud and add highlights and notes.

title: Happy Buddha Meditation App
description: Meditation app with a session timer and a wellness tracking tool.
details: A meditation app with a timer for sessions and a tool for tracking wellness.

title: BudgetScan Security Scanner
description: AI-based security scanner for pull and merge requests that sets scan depth within a cost cap and deadline. Comment-triggered service is in early access.
details: An AI-based security scanner for pull and merge requests.
It plans how deep to scan within a set cost cap and deadline. The comment-triggered service is in early access and not yet purchasable.

title: Effective Altruism Slovakia
description: Community for people looking for the most effective ways to help humans and animals, focused on the world's most urgent problems.
details: An international effective altruism community, in its Slovak form, for people looking for the most effective ways to help humans and animals.

title: PauseAI Slovensko
description: Slovak civic initiative, part of the global PauseAI movement, calling for safer, democratically supervised AI development.
details: The Slovak civic initiative of the global PauseAI movement, founded in 2023.
It calls for safer, democratically supervised AI development, including an international oversight body and a pause on training the most powerful models until their safety is proven.

title: Projekt Empatia
description: Organization that gives lectures and workshops about factory farming and promotes individual changes to dietary habits.
details: Projekt Empatia gives lectures and workshops about factory farming and promotes individual changes to dietary habits.
Its tagline: "Bez empatie niet zmeny" (without empathy, no change).
